fact: A Trapper is a massive, manta-ray-shaped predator.
source_quote: A massive, manta-ray-shaped predator known as a Trapper
subject: Trapper

fact: The party is ambushed by a Trapper in the western passages.
source_quote: navigating the western passages, the party is ambushed by a large subterranean predator
subject: ambush start

fact: The Trapper achieves surprise because no one has a passive Perception over 18.
source_quote: No one has a passive Perception over 18, so the creature achieves surprise
subject: surprise round

fact: The Trapper wraps its wings around Gyrgum and grapples him.
source_quote: wrapping its wings around Gyrgum and smothering him
subject: Gyrgum grappled

fact: Gyrgum is grappled by the Trapper and suffers damage from acidic secretions.
source_quote: Gyrgum fails a DC 13 Dexterity save and is grappled ... Gyrgum suffers severe damage from the creature's acidic secretions
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum drops to 1 hit point due to his orc ability.
source_quote: He uses his orc ability to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum fails to break free from the grapple.
source_quote: Gyrgum tries to break free and fails with a 9
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz casts magic missile at the Trapper.
source_quote: Daz scrambles to find a spell that can target the creature without harming his enveloped ally, firing magic missiles into the beast
subject: Daz

fact: Daz attempts to cast Silvery Barbs but notes it requires an attack, check, or save to trigger.
source_quote: Daz first tries Silvery Barbs but realises it needs an attack, check, or save to trigger
subject: Silvery Barbs

fact: Daz uses Silvery Barbs to force a reroll, which the Trapper succeeds against.
source_quote: Daz forces a reroll with Silvery Barbs, but it succeeds again
subject: Daz

fact: Daz casts Toll the Dead, which the Trapper saves against.
source_quote: The Trapper saves against Toll the Dead
subject: Daz

fact: Thorin attacks the Trapper with his longsword.
source_quote: Thorin hacked at the beast with his longsword, landing heavy blows
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin rolls a natural 1 on initiative.
source_quote: Thorin rolls a natural 1 for a 0 initiative
subject: Thorin

fact: Zalthir engages the Trapper in a counter-grapple.
source_quote: Zalthir rushes forward, striking the monstrosity with an unarmed blow and locking it in a counter-grapple
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir repeatedly strikes the Trapper until it dies.
source_quote: beat the enormous predator into the ground with a relentless series of strikes until it collapsed, dead
subject: Zalthir

fact: The Trapper collapses dead and releases Gyrgum.
source_quote: Zalthir delivers a final, powerful series of strikes that causes the creature to collapse dead, releasing a battered and acid-covered Gyrgum
subject: Trapper defeated

fact: The Trapper is dead.
source_quote: The party is very relieved to see the dead creature flop to the ground
subject: Trapper

fact: Gyrgum scrapes acidic residue off himself.
source_quote: Gyrgum scraped the caustic residue off himself
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum is covered in acid.
source_quote: Gyrgum suffers severe damage from the creature's acidic secretions ... Gyrgum scraped the caustic residue off himself
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The Ember Vanguard moves deeper into the tunnels after the fight.
source_quote: the Ember Vanguard pressed on into the dark
subject: Ember Vanguard

fact: The session ends with the party moving into the dark.
source_quote: The session ends here
subject: session end
